name: Converter Studio
description: Hosted file converter for video, audio, images, PDFs, documents, e-books, subtitles, data and archives (67 formats). Give it a link or a file and get a download link back, kept for 6 hours. Tools: list_formats, convert, create_upload, get_conversion, confirm_conversion and get_account. Every tool except list_formats needs a Converter Studio API key sent as an Authorization: Bearer header (create one at https://converter.studio/account#api-keys; free accounts get 13 credits a day). Without a key the server lists its tools and answers list_formats only.
author: Converter Studio
